• SBTi-Validated Climate Trajectory: Independently audited commitment to achieve a 42% Scope 1/2 reduction and 25% Scope 3 reduction by 2030, advancing toward 90% net zero by 2050 [FACT-G-02].
• Direct Decarbonisation: -74% progress in Scope 1 and 2 emissions from baseline [FACT-E-06], with 23% solar energy gains [FACT-E-07].
• Freight Risk Abatement: 1,188 tCO₂e abated via SAF contracts [FACT-E-05], insulating against rising aviation carbon compliance costs.
• Governance Excellence: FIA 3-Star Environmental Accreditation maintained [FACT-G-01], providing sponsor brand safety.
